entries.title: Unlocking Secrets on a Mac no longer freezes the app
entries.body: When you unlock Secrets and macOS asks whether Infinitary may use its saved Keychain items, your first mate and crew keep working while that question waits for your answer. Before, the whole app stopped until you answered it.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the app simply keeps responding while the Mac's own Keychain dialog is up.
